title: OpenDSU
description: Keep content, authority and history together while separating what cryptography verifies from what still requires judgment.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: OpenDSU asks what must travel with data for it to remain controllable and verifiable.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Keep content, authority and history together while separating what cryptography verifies from what still requires judgment.
readerOutcomes: The book explains why those relationships matter beyond any particular storage implementation.
Those limits make the framework an argument about composed trust, rather than magical cryptography.
Read it to judge which relationships your own digital objects need to preserve.
